messages.subject: Brightharbor Payments - Senior Backend Engineer - Virtual Onsite
messages.body:
Hi Minal,

Great news: the team would like to move you to the virtual onsite for the Senior Backend Engineer role on our Payments Platform team.

The onsite is on Friday, November 13, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite attached) and has two back-to-back sessions over Zoom:
- Coding (45 min): a live coding problem in CoderPad, any mainstream language.
- System Design (45 min): design a backend service end to end; expect to discuss payments-style consistency and idempotency.

Please reply if the time doesn't work.

Best,
Priya Raman
Technical Recruiter, Brightharbor Payments

messages.subject: Onsite with our client Orbitline Logistics
messages.body:
Hi Minal,

I'm reaching out on behalf of my client, Orbitline Logistics, for the Staff Software Engineer opening on their routing platform. They'd like you to come onsite in Seattle on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 starting at 9:00 AM PT.

The loop is four rounds: coding, low-level design (object-oriented design of a dispatch component), system design, and a behavioral round with the director.

Let me know you're confirmed and I'll send the address.

Marcus Bell
TalentBridge Staffing
